agent_documents.label: A2A Agent Card
agent_documents.name: nexus-zero
agent_documents.description: NEXUS-0 — a pay-per-call intelligence agent for autonomous AI clients. Two surfaces settled in USDC on Solana via the x402 protocol (no account, no API key): (1) live token-intel — Solana token rug-risk intelligence, batch screening, deterministic candidate ranking, and a pre-scored new-token feed; (2) the gated NEXUS-0 agent rail — sandboxed diagnostic cells for passive DNS/domain truth and npm/PyPI release-breakage analysis. Invocation is over the x402 HTTP-402 endpoints and MCP servers docume
